```{r}
# Reactome ORA Using 348 Genes that have altered CN profiles (Genome-wide Background)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(ReactomePA)
  library(enrichplot)
  library(ggplot2)
})

```

```{r}
# ====================================================
# Define paths
# ====================================================
CNV_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/CNV_PCGR/Plot/Figures"

all_unique_file <- file.path(CNV_DIR, "WES_all_unique_CNV_genes.tsv")

all_unique_genes <- read.delim(all_unique_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# =========================================
# Prepare 348 gene list
# =========================================

genes_348 <- unique(all_unique_genes$SYMBOL)

cat("[INFO] Total CNV genes (input):", length(genes_348), "\n")

```
```{r}
# =========================================
# SYMBOL -> ENTREZ mapping
# =========================================

map348 <- suppressMessages(
  bitr(
    genes_348,
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType   = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
)

mapped_entrez_348 <- unique(map348$ENTREZID)

cat("[INFO] Mapped to ENTREZ:", length(mapped_entrez_348), "of", length(genes_348), "\n")

```
```{r}
# =========================================
# Reactome ORA (Genome-wide background)
# =========================================
# Get only protein-coding genes
gene_info <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = keys(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype = "ENTREZID"),
  columns = c("ENTREZID", "GENETYPE"),
  keytype = "ENTREZID"
)

all_entrez_ids <- gene_info %>%
  dplyr::filter(GENETYPE == "protein-coding") %>%
  dplyr::pull(ENTREZID) %>%
  unique()

cat("[INFO] Universe size (protein-coding only):", length(all_entrez_ids), "\n")

er_348 <- enrichPathway(
  gene          = mapped_entrez_348,
  universe      = all_entrez_ids,
  organism      = "human",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.25,
  readable      = TRUE
)

if (is.null(er_348) || nrow(as.data.frame(er_348)) == 0) {
  stop("No significant Reactome enrichment detected.")
}

res_df_348 <- as.data.frame(er_348) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)

```
```{r}
# =========================================
# Print top pathways
# =========================================

cat("\n[TOP REACTOME TERMS]\n")

print(
  res_df_348 %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, Count, pvalue, p.adjust) %>%
    head(10)
)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================
# Direction-specific Reactome ORA
# Strict analysis and inclusive sensitivity analysis
#
# Analysis 1: Strict / clean
#   Gain-only genes: Gain in >=1 sample and never Hetdel/Homdel
#   Deletion-only genes: Hetdel/Homdel in >=1 sample and never Gain
#
# Analysis 2: Inclusive / sensitivity
#   Gain-inclusive genes: Gain in >=1 sample
#   Deletion-inclusive genes: Hetdel/Homdel in >=1 sample
#
# Genes showing both Gain and Hetdel/Homdel across different samples
# are excluded from strict analysis but included in both inclusive groups.
# ====================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyr)
})

# ====================================================
# Input and output folders for directional ORA
# ====================================================

INPUT_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/CNV_PCGR/Plot/Figures"

OUT_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/CNV_PCGR/Plot/Figures/Directional"

dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("[INFO] Input directory:\n")
cat(INPUT_DIR, "\n\n")

cat("[INFO] Output directory:\n")
cat(OUT_DIR, "\n\n")

if (!dir.exists(OUT_DIR)) {
  stop("[ERROR] Output directory does not exist and could not be created: ", OUT_DIR)
}

```
```{r}
# ====================================================
# Normalize CNV classes
# ====================================================

cnv_onecall_clean <- cnv_onecall %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample = trimws(Sample),
    SYMBOL = trimws(SYMBOL),
    VARIANT_CLASS_raw = trimws(VARIANT_CLASS),
    VARIANT_CLASS_norm = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_to_lower(VARIANT_CLASS_raw) %in% c("gain", "amp", "amplification") ~ "Gain",
      stringr::str_to_lower(VARIANT_CLASS_raw) %in% c("hetdel", "het del", "het_del", "heterozygous deletion", "loss") ~ "Hetdel",
      stringr::str_to_lower(VARIANT_CLASS_raw) %in% c("homdel", "hom del", "hom_del", "homozygous deletion") ~ "Homdel",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(SYMBOL),
    SYMBOL != "",
    !is.na(Sample),
    Sample != "",
    !is.na(VARIANT_CLASS_norm)
  )

cat("[INFO] CNV class counts after normalization:\n")
print(table(cnv_onecall_clean$VARIANT_CLASS_norm))
```
```{r}
# ====================================================
# Gene-level CNV direction summary
# ====================================================

cnv_gene_direction_summary <- cnv_onecall_clean %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_gain_samples = sum(VARIANT_CLASS_norm == "Gain"),
    gain_samples = paste(sort(unique(Sample[VARIANT_CLASS_norm == "Gain"])), collapse = ";"),
    
    n_hetdel_samples = sum(VARIANT_CLASS_norm == "Hetdel"),
    hetdel_samples = paste(sort(unique(Sample[VARIANT_CLASS_norm == "Hetdel"])), collapse = ";"),
    
    n_homdel_samples = sum(VARIANT_CLASS_norm == "Homdel"),
    homdel_samples = paste(sort(unique(Sample[VARIANT_CLASS_norm == "Homdel"])), collapse = ";"),
    
    n_deletion_samples = sum(VARIANT_CLASS_norm %in% c("Hetdel", "Homdel")),
    deletion_samples = paste(sort(unique(Sample[VARIANT_CLASS_norm %in% c("Hetdel", "Homdel")])), collapse = ";"),
    
    n_total_altered_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(Sample),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction_group = dplyr::case_when(
      n_gain_samples > 0 & n_deletion_samples == 0 ~ "Gain_only",
      n_gain_samples == 0 & n_deletion_samples > 0 ~ "Deletion_only",
      n_gain_samples > 0 & n_deletion_samples > 0 ~ "Both_gain_and_deletion",
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(direction_group, SYMBOL)

cat("[INFO] Gene direction groups:\n")
print(table(cnv_gene_direction_summary$direction_group))

write.table(
  cnv_gene_direction_summary,
  file.path(INPUT_DIR, "WES_CNV_gene_direction_summary_Gain_vs_Deletion.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
```{r}
# ====================================================
# Define strict and inclusive gene sets
# ====================================================

# Overlapping genes: Gain in at least one sample and deletion in another sample
overlap_genes <- cnv_gene_direction_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction_group == "Both_gain_and_deletion") %>%
  dplyr::pull(SYMBOL) %>%
  unique()

# Analysis 1: strict / clean sets
strict_gain_genes <- cnv_gene_direction_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction_group == "Gain_only") %>%
  dplyr::pull(SYMBOL) %>%
  unique()

strict_deletion_genes <- cnv_gene_direction_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction_group == "Deletion_only") %>%
  dplyr::pull(SYMBOL) %>%
  unique()

# Analysis 2: inclusive / sensitivity sets
inclusive_gain_genes <- cnv_gene_direction_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_gain_samples > 0) %>%
  dplyr::pull(SYMBOL) %>%
  unique()

inclusive_deletion_genes <- cnv_gene_direction_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_deletion_samples > 0) %>%
  dplyr::pull(SYMBOL) %>%
  unique()

cat("[INFO] Overlap genes:", length(overlap_genes), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Strict Gain-only genes:", length(strict_gain_genes), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Strict Hetdel/Homdel-only genes:", length(strict_deletion_genes), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Inclusive Gain genes:", length(inclusive_gain_genes), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Inclusive Hetdel/Homdel genes:", length(inclusive_deletion_genes), "\n\n")

cat("[INFO] Genes showing both Gain and Hetdel/Homdel:\n")
print(overlap_genes)

# Save gene lists
write.table(
  data.frame(SYMBOL = overlap_genes),
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_CNV_genes_both_Gain_and_Hetdel_Homdel.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  data.frame(SYMBOL = strict_gain_genes),
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_CNV_STRICT_Gain_only_genes_excluding_overlap.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  data.frame(SYMBOL = strict_deletion_genes),
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_CNV_STRICT_Hetdel_Homdel_only_genes_excluding_overlap.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  data.frame(SYMBOL = inclusive_gain_genes),
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_CNV_INCLUSIVE_Gain_genes_overlap_included.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  data.frame(SYMBOL = inclusive_deletion_genes),
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_CNV_INCLUSIVE_Hetdel_Homdel_genes_overlap_included.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================
# Helper function for Reactome ORA
# ====================================================

run_reactome_ora_directional <- function(
  gene_symbols,
  analysis_label,
  plot_title,
  out_prefix,
  universe_entrez = all_entrez_ids,
  show_category = 15
) {
  
  cat("\n====================================================\n")
  cat("[INFO] Running Reactome ORA:", analysis_label, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")
  
  gene_symbols <- unique(gene_symbols)
  gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[!is.na(gene_symbols) & gene_symbols != ""]
  
  cat("[INFO] Input SYMBOL genes:", length(gene_symbols), "\n")
  
  # -------------------------
  # Save input gene list
  # -------------------------
  input_gene_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_input_genes.tsv"))
  
  write.table(
    data.frame(SYMBOL = gene_symbols),
    input_gene_file,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("[INFO] Saved input gene list:", input_gene_file, "\n")
  
  # -------------------------
  # Too few genes case
  # -------------------------
  if (length(gene_symbols) < 5) {
    warning("[WARN] Too few genes for ORA: ", analysis_label)
    
    empty_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, ".tsv"))
    
    write.table(
      data.frame(),
      empty_file,
      sep = "\t",
      quote = FALSE,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # SYMBOL to ENTREZ mapping
  # -------------------------
  map_df <- suppressMessages(
    bitr(
      gene_symbols,
      fromType = "SYMBOL",
      toType   = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
    )
  )
  
  mapped_entrez <- unique(map_df$ENTREZID)
  
  cat("[INFO] Mapped ENTREZ genes:", length(mapped_entrez), "of", length(gene_symbols), "\n")
  
  mapped_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_mapped_ENTREZ.tsv"))
  
  write.table(
    map_df,
    mapped_file,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("[INFO] Saved mapped gene table:", mapped_file, "\n")
  
  if (length(mapped_entrez) < 5) {
    warning("[WARN] Too few mapped ENTREZ genes for ORA: ", analysis_label)
    
    empty_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, ".tsv"))
    
    write.table(
      data.frame(),
      empty_file,
      sep = "\t",
      quote = FALSE,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # Reactome enrichment
  # -------------------------
  er <- enrichPathway(
    gene          = mapped_entrez,
    universe      = universe_entrez,
    organism      = "human",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff  = 0.25,
    readable      = TRUE
  )
  
  res_df <- as.data.frame(er)
  
  if (nrow(res_df) > 0) {
    res_df <- res_df %>%
      dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)
  }
  
  out_tsv <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, ".tsv"))
  
  write.table(
    res_df,
    out_tsv,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("[INFO] Reactome terms detected:", nrow(res_df), "\n")
  cat("[INFO] Saved ORA table:", out_tsv, "\n")
  
  # -------------------------
  # Plot filenames
  # -------------------------
  out_png <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_dotplot.png"))
  out_pdf <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_dotplot.pdf"))
  
  # -------------------------
  # If no enriched terms, save blank plot
  # -------------------------
  if (nrow(res_df) == 0) {
    
    p_blank <- ggplot() +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0,
        y = 0,
        label = paste0(
          "No significant Reactome pathway enrichment\n",
          analysis_label,
          "\nInput genes: ", length(gene_symbols),
          "\nMapped genes: ", length(mapped_entrez)
        ),
        size = 5
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      ggtitle(plot_title) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
      )
    
    print(p_blank)
    
    ggsave(
      filename = out_png,
      plot = p_blank,
      width = 10,
      height = 8,
      dpi = 300
    )
    
    ggsave(
      filename = out_pdf,
      plot = p_blank,
      width = 10,
      height = 8
    )
    
    cat("[INFO] No enriched terms. Saved blank dotplot PNG:", out_png, "\n")
    cat("[INFO] No enriched terms. Saved blank dotplot PDF:", out_pdf, "\n")
    
    return(er)
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # Save real dotplot
  # -------------------------
  p <- dotplot(er, showCategory = show_category) +
    ggtitle(plot_title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = out_png,
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = out_pdf,
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 10
  )
  
  cat("[INFO] Saved dotplot PNG:", out_png, "\n")
  cat("[INFO] Saved dotplot PDF:", out_pdf, "\n")
  
  return(er)
}
```

```{r}
# ====================================================
# Analysis 1: STRICT / clean directional ORA
# Overlap genes excluded from both groups
# ====================================================

er_strict_gain <- run_reactome_ora_directional(
  gene_symbols = strict_gain_genes,
  analysis_label = "STRICT Gain-only genes excluding overlap",
  plot_title = paste0(
    "Reactome ORA - Strict Gain-only CNV genes\n",
    "Overlap genes excluded; n = ", length(strict_gain_genes)
  ),
  out_prefix = "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_STRICT_Gain_only_excluding_overlap"
)

er_strict_deletion <- run_reactome_ora_directional(
  gene_symbols = strict_deletion_genes,
  analysis_label = "STRICT Hetdel/Homdel-only genes excluding overlap",
  plot_title = paste0(
    "Reactome ORA - Strict Hetdel/Homdel CNV genes\n",
    "Overlap genes excluded; n = ", length(strict_deletion_genes)
  ),
  out_prefix = "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_STRICT_Hetdel_Homdel_only_excluding_overlap"
)
```
```{r}
# ====================================================
# Analysis 2: INCLUSIVE / sensitivity directional ORA
# Overlap genes included in both categories
# ====================================================

er_inclusive_gain <- run_reactome_ora_directional(
  gene_symbols = inclusive_gain_genes,
  analysis_label = "INCLUSIVE Gain genes with overlap included",
  plot_title = paste0(
    "Reactome ORA - Inclusive Gain CNV genes\n",
    "Overlap genes included; n = ", length(inclusive_gain_genes)
  ),
  out_prefix = "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_INCLUSIVE_Gain_overlap_included"
)

er_inclusive_deletion <- run_reactome_ora_directional(
  gene_symbols = inclusive_deletion_genes,
  analysis_label = "INCLUSIVE Hetdel/Homdel genes with overlap included",
  plot_title = paste0(
    "Reactome ORA - Inclusive Hetdel/Homdel CNV genes\n",
    "Overlap genes included; n = ", length(inclusive_deletion_genes)
  ),
  out_prefix = "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_INCLUSIVE_Hetdel_Homdel_overlap_included"
)
```
